"Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

Mientras custodia a un sospechoso relevante, Leaphorn descubre que detrás de este crimen hay más de lo que hubiera imaginado. Manuelito se enfrenta a sus peores temores. Chee debe elegir entre su carrera y su pueblo.
Leaphorn, Chee y Manuelito descienden al escondite de la Sociedad Búfalo. Allá dentro, se enfrentan a unas duras decisiones que podrían cambiar el resto de sus vidas.
El policía tribal navajo Joe Leaphorn investiga la muerte de un hombre involucrado en una misteriosa secta, mientras Jim Chee, pluriempleado como detective privado, trabaja en su propio caso.

Leaphorn profundiza en los vínculos personales que lo unen a un caso cada vez más enigmático. El sargento Manuelito interroga a Chee, aunque se muestra reticente a hacerlo. El hallazgo de un cadáver provoca que Leaphorn y Manuelito busquen a un niño.

Chee empieza a actuar por su propia cuenta tras el encuentro con un hombre peligroso. Leaphorn y Manuelito establecen una alianza con el sheriff del departamento, lo que le permite a Leaphorn encontrar una pista muy importante.

Leaphorn pone en peligro su vida durante la persecución de un sospechoso. Manuelito desafía al sheriff con la intención de rescatar a su jefe. Chee reflexiona sobre una propuesta peligrosa que le ofrecerá respuestas sobre el caso.

Leaphorn trabaja a contrarreloj para obtener una confesión de un sospechoso antes de que deje de estar bajo su custodia. Mientras tanto, Chee se introduce de incógnito en la secta que vincula sus distintas investigaciones.

Fiona Bruce and the team are at Tewkesbury Abbey in Gloucestershire; two sisters gifted with their great-great-grandmother's jewelry are drawn into the "battle of the bangles" to find out who has the finest inheritance.

Fiona Bruce and the team visit Audley End near Saffron Walden in Essex; the experts discover a varied set of items including the sword that ended the War of Independence in America, a collection of toilet chains and vases decorated with fairies.

A return visit to Audley End in Essex sees Fiona Bruce and the team of experts meeting thousands of visitors who are bringing family treasures for appraisal; amongst objects is a table that was supposedly used to sign Napoleon's abdication.
Fiona Bruce and the team of experts make a return visit to Hanbury Hall near Droitwich in Worcestershire, where it seems that extraordinarily large objects are the talking point of the day.

Fiona Bruce and the team head to Cheshire for a day of busy valuations at Arley Hall and Gardens; combing through the thousands of objects brought in by visitors the experts are excited to find two items that have spent many years hidden from view.

A return visit to the enchanting gardens of Arley Hall in Cheshire finds Fiona Bruce and the team of experts hard at work; amongst the objects featured are a portrait of a visitor's mother which was painted in India in the 1950s.

A return visit for Fiona Bruce and the team to the magnificent Broughton Castle near Banbury in Oxfordshire; objects exciting the team include two very large portraits depicting servants who worked at the castle in the 18th century.

Fiona Bruce and the team visit the tranquil, moated manor house of Baddesley Clinton; a busy day of valuations uncovers more fascinating finds including a glittering diamond bracelet once worn by Hollywood star Rita Hayworth.

A return visit to Baddesley Clinton finds Fiona and the experts poring over more family heirlooms complete with memorable stories; treasures brought to the cameras include a silver box described by an excited silver expert as "exceptionally rare".
Board Britain's most famous steam locomotive to celebrate the golden age of travel.

Fiona Bruce looks at the most talked-about finds of 2016 and reveals surprising updates; a missing work by eminent Victorian artist Alma-Tadema appeared on the show, and we follow the newly restored painting as it ends up in an exhibition.

Fiona Bruce and the team make a return visit to Tewkesbury Abbey in Gloucestershire to uncover more treasures; amongst the objects featured are an extremely heavy Tudor table, and an extensive collection of Maundy Money.

México es país productor y de tránsito de Fentanilo, un opioide sintético cada vez más consumido en Estados Unidos. Esta droga causa muchas muertes entre jóvenes. Un kilo de fentanilo genera las mismas ganancias que una tonelada de cocaína.

Ante la incompetencia de las autoridades, muchos familiares se han convertido en investigadores privados aficionados dispuestos a enfrentar riesgos. Ellos dicen vivir una carrera contra el tiempo para evitar que sus seres queridos desaparezcan.

El ejército mexicano despliega un operativo en Culiacán, Sinaloa, para detener a un familiar de Joaquín Guzmán Loera, 'El Chapo'. El objetivo es capturado y, durante un día, Culiacán queda atrapada en un enfrentamiento entre el ejército y los narcos.
Dos hermanas convirtieron una deliciosa receta de su madre en un gran negocio. Un hombre pasó de ser astronauta a cultivar las mejores uvas para hacer vino.
Tras múltiples denuncias, una red de oscuros secretos y abusos a menores es descubierta. Los líderes de una iglesia se ven envueltos en terribles crímenes que tendrán que pagar en prisión.
El tráfico ilegal de personas entre República Dominicana y Puerto Rico ha aumentado en los últimos meses, las autoridades hacen todo lo que pueden para mejorar la situación.

Un hombre habla sobre el infierno que vivió con la desaparición de su esposa, pues no solo sufría por ella al no saber donde estaba, también tuvo que lidiar con el hecho de que se convirtió en el principal sospechoso.

Entre lágrimas, un niño le confiesa a su madre adoptiva que quiere volver con su familia biológica. Estrellas latinas del Cirque du Soleil hablan sobre el cambio drástico en sus vidas tras la pandemia, pues se vieron obligadas a dejar los shows.
Una madre decide hacer lo que sea para vengar la muerte de su hijo sin pensar en las consecuencias que eso podría ocasionar.
Una avalancha de inmigrantes abarrota la frontera y pone a prueba la capacidad del gobierno para manejar una nueva crisis humanitaria, la tensión entre ciudades fronterizas crece.

Sacerdotes y pastores en ambos lados de la frontera tienen que enfrentar las agresiones de los cárteles de la droga. Ellos cuentan los ataques a sus iglesias y albergues, y algunos llevan armas de fuego bajo sus sotanas.
La muerte de un gurú ha generado misterio y dudas entre sus seguidores. Solo cuatro personas sobrevivieron a la tragedia del vuelo 965 y aún lidian con el dolor y el trauma.
Miles de migrantes quieren pasar a la frontera para ir a Panamá, buscan la manera de llegar a Estados Unidos a pesar de los peligros que tienen que enfrentar.
La hamburguesa, un delicioso alimento que cautiva a cualquiera con su delicioso sabor y preparación. Lo importante es aprender a cocinarla de la manera correcta.
The battle between Shelby Stanga and Richard comes to a head; Buck and Swilley's boat goes boom; a greenhorn at Big Gun shows his dark side; Joe and Coatsy bury the hatchet.

Gabe's two-yarder plan goes further off track when one crew member defects to the other team; Big Gun races their tightest deadline yet; Joe and the new guy get into it; an accident could take S&S out of the Log-Off for good.

At Rygaard, a crew shakeup leaves everyone scrambling; S&S suffers a blow; Buck and Swilley get unexpected help from James; Papac takes to the open seas for a fishing trip; Big Gun brings in a new yarder operator.

Jimmy Smith braves the depths of the Suwannee River; Shelby takes on a log that flipped his winch last season; the boys of Siderius play fast and loose; Rygaard pushes their yarder to the brink of disaster.

Gabe's two yarder sides are reunited; the alliance between team Buck and James Smith comes to a bitter end; Joe's hard-yarding style sends the rigging crew running for cover; two new teams of ox loggers enter the race.

Shelby finds something that could lead to the biggest payday ever; Craig and Wayne plot a prank to teach Dave a lesson; personality differences between the ox loggers cause walk-offs on both sides; James returns to S&S.
An accident sends one man over the edge of the landing at Papac; greenhorn Jesse Kelleher is in need of redemption; the swamp man gets into a shootout.

Shelby chases buried gold in Lake Pontchartrain; a surprising end to the log-off forces sudden death in Florida; a greenhorn's mistake could cost Big Gun's season's profits; the ox loggers and cowboys of Siderius fight to finish their seasons strong.

Pushing hard pushes Joe to his breaking point; Dave wears out his welcome at Rygaard; the teams fight to win the final round of the log-off in the Suwannee; bad blood between Jimmy and James comes to a head.
Rick travels to Phuket to learn the art of hot and sour tom yum goong.
Rick explores the multi-faceted cuisines of Penang; in Sri Lanka, he continues his passion for seafood by visiting a bustling fishing village.
Rick visits Sri Lanka and discovers a wealth of hot and spicy vegetable curries.
Curry is at the top of Rick's list as he ends his culinary tour in Bangladesh.
The series kicks off with a complete guide to cooking on coals, from lighting the fire to the barbecue essentials; Ainsley also tests different types of barbecues.
Visiting the Greek Island of Alonnisos to sample traditional barbecue consisting of spit-roasted lamb and hortopita.
Visiting South Africa to find unusual recipes for cooking over coals.
Visiting Thailand to sample a unique recipe for fish and chips and a barbecue cornucopia.
The history of Jamaican barbecue recipes from the Arawaks over 1,200 years ago.
Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

On a misty lagoon in Sardinia Rick watches the fishermen catch mullet using the same methods as the Romans did centuries before. He boards a ferry for Sicily to find, in the heart of Palermo, one of the best pasta dishes he's ever tasted.
Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.
Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.
Architect Lina Ghotmeh leads a Paris practice using her ethos of "archaeology of the future"; she now brings this vision to her most ambitious project: redesigning the British Museum's Western Range.
Join our "AI Decoded" team as we unpack and take a deep dive into the world of artificial intelligence.
Journalists shed light on global affairs and analyze the ways media organizations present controversial topics and social issues.

John Simpson brings his expertise to bear on critical stories; through discussion with the BBC's range of experts across the world, he uses their unique local knowledge dig deeper than headlines to find the unspun truth about the world.
Alasdair Keane visits Schiphol Airport to see how self-driving vehicles are being trialled; Nick Kwek is at the Imperial War Museum in London to hear how survivor stories are brought to life.
Exploring new destinations around the globe and uncovering hidden sides to some of the world's favorite holiday hotspots.
The host sits down with experts to shed light on various issues from the business world and interviews them on the latest innovations in technology.
A look into Myanmar's multifaceted civil war to track the illicit funds powering the conflict and reveal its human cost.
How the son of a key adviser to Iran Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei built a secret oil empire.
A police raid in a small Philippine town reveals a young mayor's alleged ties to a $2 billion Singapore money laundering scandal and Chinese espionage.

Brazil's deforestation rate is falling, but Bolivia's is accelerating; investigating whether protecting forests in one country simply pushes development across the border.

Trump administration raids in Charlotte, North Carolina, set off a chain reaction: damaging local businesses and potentially causing long-term economic harm. New data reveals how the deportation campaign may leave social and economic voids.
With homeownership out of reach, AI cutting job prospects and index funds feeling too slow, many young investors are turning to meme stocks, options and crypto in the hope of securing their future.
Already home to SpaceX, Blue Origin and recent moon-landers Firefly Aerospace and Intuitive Machines, Texas is quickly becoming the center of the commercial space universe.

Jeffrey Epstein built a network of elites across finance, politics and academia. By analyzing thousands of documents, Bloomberg mapped its reach and how it widened even as allegations against him accumulated.
Francine Lacqua meets Bharti Enterprises Founder Sunil Mittal to hear how he went from selling bicycle parts to navigating a battle for control of India's telecom market.
Francine Lacqua speaks with Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala about leading under pressure, from fighting corruption to leading the World Trade Organization at a time of unprecedented disruption.
Blackstone CEO Stephen Schwarzman helped private equity go from niche to mainstream. He speaks with Francine Lacqua about how he spots investment opportunities and where the world will shift next.
Former U.K. Prime Minister Theresa May speaks with Francine Lacqua about Vladimir Putin and her approach to leadership in a world seeing a rise in strongmen.
Speaking to Christine Lagarde about Europe's economic travails, populism and how to lead through turbulent times.

Ajay Banga discusses his journey to becoming president of the World Bank Group; from his childhood in India to a career in the private sector and eventually leading a globally influential institution.
Bloomberg Originals unpacks how the artificial intelligence boom has resulted in a concentration of immense wealth, pushing global trade imbalances to levels unseen since the 2008 financial crisis.
The idea of flying cars has largely remained science fiction, until now; a new generation of electrified aircraft is attracting the attention of investors and venture capitalists around the world.
Scientists are developing more powerful magnets to enable clean energy sources like fusion; China's dominance of the supply chain for rare earth magnets threatens their global availability.
Transformers are critical to the power grid, but the rise of renewables and surging energy demand are pushing them to their limits; could the solid-state transformer meet these new challenges?
Semiconductors power modern technology, from AI to everyday devices; global tensions and rising demand are forcing the chip supply chain to adapt.
Nuclear power is attempting a comeback, but producing the necessary fuel is complex. From mining to enrichment, can new technologies and supply chains scale to power the next generation of reactors?
AI's rapid growth is pushing global energy demand skyward, forcing electrical grids to expand and modernize. Now, companies from China to Nigeria are investing in new tech to power the future.
Hong Kong's MTR is the most profitable subway in the world thanks to a lucrative real estate strategy; it's taking on record debt for a government-mandated tech hub with uncertain demand.
Dinosaur fossils have become a high-end collectibles market, with auction prices reaching tens of millions of dollars. The attempted sale of Shen, a rare T. Rex planned for auction at Christie's.

Ian Schafer speaks with Knicks Fan TV founder CP, Rebecca Chasen of Knicks Film School and Shaun of The Knicks Wall about how digital creators turn sports fandom into independent media brands; using the New York Knicks fan base as a model, the panel examines revenue generation through live shows, sponsorships, merchandise and events, while analyzing lessons traditional broadcast networks can draw from creator-led digital platforms.
Expanding from database software into AI and media, Larry Ellison is placing his biggest bets yet; Bloomberg Originals explores what drives the 82-year-old tech billionaire.

The content, capital and connectivity powering Tech's most groundbreaking ideas, from industrial robots and bleeding-edge consumer electronics to data center build-out costs and the race to reach artificial general intelligence.
A recap of the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum, held in New Delhi in October 2026, featuring interviews with global leaders in business and government. Hosted by Erik Schatzker.

Alexis Ohanian, an internet entrepreneur and investor, advocates for increased investment in women's sports and explains why he believes these investments will yield greater returns than his shares in Reddit.
Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly talk with Renee Montgomery about why she decided to retire from the WNBA to co-own the team.
Mishal Husain interviews Oscar-nominated composer and pianist Max Richter, who discusses his album `While The Flood Rages' and explains his creative process and what music means to him.
En vista de que su esposa no puede darle el hijo que él añora, un hombre se consuela engañándola cada vez que puede.

La taquera callejera Nicolasa alcanza una gran popularidad y pone en peligro al restaurante de unos estudios de cine. Cuando se descubre que trae fortuna a su clientela, todos empiezan a considerarla una especie de talismán al que no deben perder la oportunidad de acudir.
Un hombre se enamora de una rica heredera y la ayuda a pelear contra su tío que quiere quedarse con su fortuna.
Eugenia Grandet se enamora de su primo Carlos y, cuando desean formalizar su compromiso, el padre de Eugenia se opone porque sospecha que el novio solo busca su fortuna.
Dieter es un niño que está muy feliz con la pelota que su padre le regaló, un día esta va a parar al otro lado del muro.
Un hombre vagabundo sale de la cárcel luego salva a un niño de ser ahogado y es recompensado por sus padres.
CBS Sports HQ analysts break down the day's top stories and highlights.
In-depth analysis and insight on the hottest topics in college football.
CBS Sports' college football experts preview this weekend's matchups.
Stick with HQ all weekend for in-game updates, postgame recaps and previews of upcoming matchups.
CBS Sports' experts and analysts preview today's top matchups.

Bruce sits down with Thomas Cahill to discuss his unique journey from the laboratory to the forefront of life sciences investing, with advanced degrees from Duke University and a foundation in chemistry.

Thomas Cahill dives deeper into the venture creation model that has made Newpath Partners a force in biotechnology; Tom is a founder, investor and board member across numerous groundbreaking healthcare companies.

At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, get a look inside the future of transportation, technology and innovation with industry leaders Mikell Taylor, Director of Robotics Strategy at GM; Chris Yu, Founder and President of ALSO; Robby Stein, Vice President of Product at Google Search; and Bosco Lai, CEO of Little Place Labs. From robotics and electric mobility to AI-powered search and satellite intelligence, these innovators are exploring how emerging technologies are transforming lives.
Deep dive into the world of international defense and military issues.

The Pentagon is pouring billions into Drone Dominance; we go inside the companies building the future of drone warfare, from armed drones and smart rifles to laser weapons and the power systems behind them.

Explore the allure and rising momentum of gold as an alternative investment, especially as prices soar to all-time highs; from ancient empires to modern portfolios, discover why gold continues to shine as a hedge against inflation.
Discover the innovators behind NYC's changing landscape, from Central Park to Brooklyn's Domino Park; an inside look inside Soho's high-tech social wellness club.
Hosts robot fights from competitors all over the world.
Cosmetic dentist designs celebrity smiles; new laser zaps unwanted tattoos; Elysium develops "Fountain of Youth" pill.
Many don't know it, but New York is a city that runs on steam; it's one of the few cities that relies on the old technology to heat some of its famous buildings.
New York has some famous bridges; these engineering examples have helped set the tone for how bridges around the world are designed.
New York City might be known as the concrete jungle, but its nearly 30,000 acres of park space have been an ever-present part of this metropolis.
Keeping the lights on in New York City is no easy task; as New York moves towards a greener future, the manner of generating electricity will have to evolve.
Un sacerdote es asignado a una iglesia abandonada, de un pueblo donde la gente ha perdido sus valores y la fe en Dios.
El supervisor de una hacienda trata de deshacerse de una joven mimada, pero se enamora de ella.

José Luis, hijo de un hacendado, decide ir en contra de su familia casándose con Esperanza, una campesina humilde. Su padre lo echa de la casa para oponerse a la boda y porque se enteró de que es parte de la Revolución Mexicana. Unos falsos revolucionarios invaden la hacienda y asesinan al padre de José Luis, y así comienza una cadena de venganzas y tragedias.
Tras la violación de su hija por parte de varios trabajadores ferroviarios, una enfermera se convierte por las noches en una letal prostituta que asesina a hombres.
Unos recién casados deciden divorciarse, pero ninguno quiere mudarse, y deciden levantar una pared en medio de la casa.
La historia de la aparición de la Virgen de Guadalupe al indio Juan Diego en México.

Un científico nazi, usando la ciudad perdida de Atlantis como su base de operaciones, amenaza con destruir la civilización con una bomba nuclear. El científico nazi quiere que el Tercer Reich empiece a gobernar de nuevo y si sus demandas no se cumplen, él seguirá adelante con su amenaza de aniquilación nuclear. Con muy poco tiempo que perder, Santo es enlistado para encontrar la bomba nuclear, desarmarla y poner fin al plan diabólico del científico nazi.
Una joven es tímida y reprimida por influencia de su madre, pero un día conoce a un músico y se desinhibe totalmente.

Former oil rig worker John Sanders (Lou Diamond Phillips) became a Louisiana fishing captain after a tragic accident ended his career. In need of money, he agrees to help his ex-wife, Kelli (Kristy Swanson), whose company is having trouble extracting oil upriver. Meanwhile, thugs working for a Jamaican gangster head to the same bayou searching for $3 million buried underwater. Both the scientists and the criminals are menaced by a man-eating shark that can survive in fresh water.

Bill Johnson leads a group of scientists into the jungles of Borneo. They are searching for the mythical black orchid, which can supposedly grant eternal life. Unfortunately, massive anacondas have been feeding on the orchids for years. When their boat goes over a waterfall, the scientists land right in the middle of the snakes' home.

French police officer Alain Moreau makes an astonishing discovery: Mikhail, a man who died recently in a breakneck car chase, is the twin brother he never knew. Alain then uncovers a web of family secrets that lead him to New York City, where his brother was involved with the Russian Mafia. Teaming up with Mikhail's lover, Alex Minetti, Alain must now assume his twin's identity and go undercover to avenge Mikhail's death.
After arresting a contract killer, a Louisiana detective tries to convince him to become an informant in an attempt to bring down the South's most powerful criminal organization.

Gordon Jennings (Idris Elba) and his friends enjoy a luxurious lifestyle funded by bank robberies, and they avoid capture by sticking to a strict set of rules. As they celebrate the latest job, a former associate arrives with a daring plan to rob an armored car. The lure of so much cash is too tempting to resist but, unbeknown to Gordon's men, this heist puts them on a collision course with Russian mobsters and a detective (Matt Dillon) who will do anything to capture them.

During an impromptu trip to Europe to mend a broken heart, math teacher Frank Tupelo (Johnny Depp) finds himself in an extraordinary situation when an alluring stranger, Elise (Angelina Jolie), places herself in his path. Their seemingly innocent flirtation turns into a dangerous game of cat and mouse while various people, who all think that Frank is Elise's thieving paramour, Alexander Pearce, try to capture the pair.

The story of Gwen Cummings (Sandra Bullock), a successful New York writer living in the fast lane and everyone's favorite party girl -- until she gets drunk with boyfriend Jasper (Dominic West), borrows her sister's (Elizabeth Perkins) wedding limo and earns herself a stay in court-ordered rehab.

During World War II, Englishwoman Stella (Sophia Loren) is involved with Capt. Ford (Trevor Howard), who commands a military tugboat. Ford's mission is dangerous because his slow-moving ship is an easy target. Eventually, he is gunned down in action and Capt. Ross (William Holden) replaces him. Before long, Ross also begins a relationship with Stella, but she warns the newcomer that she may be cursed -- captain after captain has come through her door, and each has met the same grim fate at sea.

Distraught when her middle-aged lover breaks a date with her, 21-year-old Toni Simmons (Goldie Hawn) attempts suicide. Impressed by her action, her lover, dentist Julian Winston (Walter Matthau) reconsiders marrying Toni, but he worries about her insistence on honesty. Having fabricated a wife and three children, Julian readily accepts when his devoted nurse, Stephanie (Ingrid Bergman), who has secretly loved Julian for years, offers to act as his wife and demand a divorce.

This lauded drama follows the Youngers, an African-American family living together in an apartment in Chicago. Following the death of their patriarch, they try to determine what to do with the substantial insurance payment they'll soon receive. Opinions on what to do with the money vary. Walter Lee (Sidney Poitier) wants to make a business investment, while his mother, Lena (Claudia McNeil), is intent on buying a house for them all to live in -- two differing views of the American Dream.

When the idealistic young Jefferson Smith (James Stewart) winds up appointed to the United States Senate, he gains the mentorship of Senator Joseph Paine (Claude Rains). However, Paine isn't as noble as his reputation would indicate, and he becomes involved in a scheme to discredit Smith, who wants to build a boys' campsite where a more lucrative project could go. Determined to stand up against Paine and his corrupt peers, Smith takes his case to the Senate floor.

At an Army barracks in Hawaii in the days preceding the attack on Pearl Harbor, lone-wolf soldier and boxing champion Prew Prewitt (Montgomery Clift) refuses to box, preferring to play the bugle instead. Hard-hearted Capt. Holmes (Philip Ober) subjects Prew to a grueling series of punishments while, unknown to Holmes, the gruff but fair Sgt. Warden (Burt Lancaster) engages in a clandestine affair with the captain's mistreated wife (Deborah Kerr).
A sheriff (Tim McCoy) flirts with a local girl (Marceline Day) and chases an outlaw called the Shadow.
Two brothers (Kurt Russell, Tim Matheson), one raised by Indians, seek their sister in the 1890s West.
A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.
A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.

Dr. Allen Seward (Robert Francis) is the new doctor at a remote Army outpost. His liberal attitudes towards Native Americans become a source of tension between him and his superiors, especially Capt. Peter Blake (Philip Carey), who regards all Native Americans as dangerous and untrustworthy. Seward's insistence on treating several local Kiowa tribespeople for malaria further enrages Blake, who deems Seward a traitor when the Kiowa join forces with the Comanches and attack the fort.

Former Union soldier John Parrish (Glenn Ford) wants to sell his ranch and start a new life by settling down out east. However, the ruthless tactics of Lew Wilkison (Edward G. Robinson), the scheming businessman interested in his property, make Parrish reconsider the move, especially after one of his ranch hands is murdered. Adding to the increasingly tense conflict is Wilkison's wife, Martha (Barbara Stanwyck), who is cheating on her husband with his brother, Cole (Brian Keith).
A wounded cowboy (Tim McCoy) catches rustlers who use a trick branding iron.
A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.
Dos hermanos atropellan a un niño por estar influenciados por el alcohol y lo abandonan a suerte para que no los acusen de intento de asesinato.

Silvia se enamora de Leonardo, un hombre engreído y flojo. Silvia se entera que su novio se casará con otra mujer porque está embarazada. Tiempo después Leonardo busca nuevamente a Silvia tras divorciarse de su esposa, para proponerle que regresen.

Javier, un diseñador lleno de sueños y proyectos, trabaja con su novia. Juntos trabajan en un proyecto que les dará reconocimiento a su agencia de publicidad. Javier, enamorado de su Lulú, desea formalizar su compromiso.

Una joven incita a su mejor amiga a consumir alcohol para agradarle a un chico, pero ella bebe en exceso y el joven abusa de ella. Las chicas se dan cuenta de los peligros de consumir alcohol y buscan ayuda.

Una joven va a una audición para una película y canta una canción que ella escribió, pero el director trata de aprovecharse de ella. El director de la película le roba la canción a la joven y la registra como suya, pero ella logra desenmascararlo.

Patricio tiene que abandonar a su familia para ir a trabajar al norte. Martín, su hijo se molesta, pues no comprende la situación. El hermano de Patricio busca a su familia para quedarse a vivir con ellos y apoyarlos.

Un chico descubre que una de sus compañeras de la escuela es molestada por otras niñas y le dice que él la va a defender. La chica le cree, pero cuando se da cuenta de que a él le gusta la niña que la molesta queda decepcionada.

Un chico se vuelve adicto a fumar sin saber que eso le traerá grandes problemas con sus sueños de ser un gran jugador de fútbol, además de hacerle daño a su hermano menor ocasionándole una gran enfermedad.
Un hombre que engaña a su esposa, sale con su amigo sin saber que sus intenciones son malas y que está enamorado de su esposa.

Una señora es asaltada por tres hombres que la golpean en la espalda dejándola paralítica, su hijo trata de defenderla, pero también es golpeado por ellos. El joven comienza a tomar clases de kung-fu para vengarse de los asaltantes.
Una joven y su familia desperdician el agua, el hijo más pequeño les pide que ahorren el agua, pero no lo escuchan. Por accidente su casa se incendia y no tienen agua para combatir el fuego.
Young female students disappear with alarming frequency from the college town of Santa Cruz, Calif.; when mutilated body parts show up, the police begin receiving calls from the murderer.
A killer bursts into a Honolulu conference room and leaves behind seven dead, spreading panic throughout the island.
A meek night-shift nurse finds godlike power by having life-or-death control over hospital patients, serially killing as many as 40.

Midsomer Barton is celebrating Oak Apple Week when a mother is found drowned. It looks like suicide, and that she was driven to it by grief over her dead daughter. Barnaby investigates and is shaken by two villagers who look like murder victims from his past. Then another body is discovered, and it appears that the festivities have stirred up a cocktail of adultery, contempt, unrequited love and revenge in the village.

The death of wealthy aristocrat Sir Freddy Butler brings Barnaby and Jones to the privileged surroundings of Haddington Hall. It looks like Freddy suffered a heart attack, but when his will disappears and his lawyer is killed in an arson attack, the detectives close in on Freddy's family. What are they hiding, and where are the mysterious Haddington diamonds?

When council clerk Martin Barrett is shot dead, Barnaby and Jones discover that he was an expert blackmailer. They investigate which of his victims hated him enough to kill him, and the trail leads to Fennacombe Bay. Why are Richard and Maggie Florian spending so much time at sea, and could police committee chairman Sir John Waverley have a scandalous past? With the help of Barnaby, they intend to find out.

A battle of the sexes which has raged in Broughton since the First World War comes to a head when ageing feminist Mildred Danvers is found dead after returning to her childhood home. As Barnaby investigates, the misogynist vicar Rev Gantis is shot through the head during a humiliating donkey race at the village fair. Is the killer on the side of the men or women - or do tragedies in Broughton's past hold the answer?

Controversial plans to build a supermarket in Elverton-cum-Latterly lead to murder when a man is stabbed to death and the pollution advisor for the site seems to be spending more time with the women of the village than at work. Can Barnaby and Jones discover the truth and learn what is really polluting Elverton?

When Midsomer Worthy's baritone Connor Simpson is killed just days before a competition, the rest of the choir, including Joyce Barnaby, are in fear for their lives. Barnaby and Jones investigate and find an atmosphere of bitter rivalry and tense marital relationships. Then, there's another murder and the race is on to catch the killer before the choral showdown.

La policía encuentra un testigo que afirma que Linda fue asesinada. Los fantasmas de sus crímenes persiguen a Bernarda. Una vecina cree haber visto a Juanjo, así que Nati y Max salen a buscarlo y lo encuentran entre los indigentes.

Nora toma varias pastillas para quitarse la vida y Rebeca culpa a Alonso por lo sucedido, Lalo le dice a Nazario que sospecha que el responsable del ataque que sufrió Marcelo fue Amador. Nora descubre que su mamá recibe llamadas de otro hombre.

Romina y Aaron planean separar a Emiliano y Paloma. Carlota busca papeles importantes. Cristóbal decide ser sacerdote. Bermúdez anuncia a Paloma que está dispuesto a pagarle los estudios en la Ciudad de México.
Alicia se enfrenta con Sergio y con Julieta por la situación que está pasando Yuri. Mientras tanto, Mabe seduce a Martín en su festejo por estar en libertad.

Silvana está muy ilusionada avanzando en los preparativos de la boda. Marcela le cuenta a Alba todo lo que ha sucedido en su ausencia. Alessandro se pone celoso al ver a Emiliano y Marcela tomados de la mano.
Gasca interroga a Marina acerca de Victoria y Sara. En tanto, Hipólita va a visitar a Luis a casa de Cristóbal y le pide que se recupere porque Rafael y ella lo necesitan.

Cristóbal le cuenta a Isabel que Luis está muy herido, ella le dice que puso el palacio a su nombre porque siempre será su sobrino. Mientras tanto, Marcos le cuenta a Felipe que Gasca dijo que quizás Luis no regrese.

Karina se entera de que Irene viajó a Nueva York y decide buscar a Alonso para tratar de conquistarlo. Rodrigo presiona a Natalia para tener intimidad con ella. Eleazar le pide a una mujer que seduzca a Paolo, pero su plan no funciona.
Ivette y Viviana tienen un enfrentamiento que termina en tragedia. Juan Miguel desenmascara a Ivette.

Juanjo se reúne con Doña Milagros. Bernarda llama a María para hablarle de su madre. Osvaldo se despide de Max y le pide que cuide a su madre y a su hermana, que luche por su felicidad, por María y que acabe con la farsa de su matrimonio.
Magdalena y Arturo se ganan un viaje a Canadá y ella les presume a todos los vecinos. Germán y Pedro planean engañar a Benito para ganar una apuesta.
Vítor y Albertano están a punto de conseguir un gran empleo, pero no se los dan porque les hace falta su certificado de estudios y deciden inscribirse en una escuela abierta.
A los héroes no se les hace fácil comenzar una nueva vida, mientras que estrellas del mundo grupero graban un disco en su homenaje. A Zacarías, ya convertido en solista, se le suben los humos.
Los integrantes de la banda toman caminos separados detrás de sus sueños. Márgara le confiesa a Natasha que todo fue una farsa. Apolinar se entera y termina con ella, para quedarse con Natasha.
Zacarías termina su relación con doña Olegaria y comienza a trabajar con el Trácalas. Natasha trata de convencer a Apolinar para dar a conocer la verdad a través de un documental.
Márgara trata de reunir a los héroes y Zacarías regresa a la banda. Hassan secuestra a Prisca. Los héroes se presentan ante los medios y hay reacciones encontradas.

Los famosos enfurecen porque las ventas del disco homenaje se desploman. Zacarías entra en terapia y trata de bajar de peso. Los héroes no reciben la respuesta que esperaban de los fans y piensan en pedirle a Zacarías que deje la banda.
El trabajo en un taller automotor exige un nivel de conocimiento que Vítor y Albertano creen tener. Las consecuencias de su inexperiencia serán toda una aventura.
Albertano y Vítor encuentran trabajo en un centro nocturno solo para hombres y Nacho con un puesto de hot-dogs intenta llevar dinero a la casa.
Vítor y Albertano acompañan a Lupita al mandado lo que no es una buena decisión porque tienen que enfrentarse al güero, mientras que doña Cuca y Nacho se quedan solos en casa.

Albertano se sube al metro a cantar para pedir dinero, se encuentra con el Vítor vendiendo discos piratas y se enoja con él porque quiere quitarle la clientela. Un policía les ordena a Albertano y al Vítor que se bajen.

Vítor y Albertano impiden un robo en la colonia, deciden cumplir una labor muy importante y se enlistan en la academia de policía, pero la autoridad no está lista para recibir a este par tan peculiar.
A Lorena le incomodan los ruidos que hacen los recién casados, Silvita y Luis. Germán se encargará de arreglar la tubería tapada del departamento de Lorena.
Frankie regresa a vivir al edificio, con Lorena y con Benito, pero con la condición de que encuentre trabajo. Pero, en vez de eso, escribirá una nueva película.
Vanessa regresa y los vecinos deben ponerla al día sobre todo lo que ha ocurrido. Benito aprovecha que sus padres no están e invita a su novia Liz a ver una película en su casa.
Como Luis le ha preparado el desayuno, Silvita se encargará de prepararle a su esposo un platillo espectacular.
Al vecindario llega un mecánico, quien pondrá su taller en la calle justo afuera del edificio. Cris motivará a Pedro para que limpie el departamento por primera vez.
La familia Peluche va al supermercado y luchan por un lugar de estacionamiento. Federica se pone celosa de que Ludovico habla gustosamente con la señorita de la carnicería.

Federica intenta seducir a Ludovico, pero él no se da cuenta y ella llora porque perdieron la llama de la pasión. Ludovico y Federica buscan como reavivar su matrimonio y hacen un juego de cambio de personalidad.
El novio de Bibi, Manuel, la invita a Valle del Nabo a pasar el fin de semana. La familia de Bibi los alcanza en casa de Manuel. Manuel termina con Bibi por ser amargada y rara.
La familia P. Luche festeja el Día de las Madres de una manera muy particular. Ludovico intenta componer el baño, pero un plomero muy guapo lo ayudará.

Manuel y Matilde se encuentran; él le pregunta si tuvo algo que ver con la decisión de Adolfo de ponerlo en libertad y ella, llorando, le dice que le prometió irse con él si lo salvaba. Manuel se despide de sus amigos y le jura a Matilde regresar.

Octavio le pide a Maricruz que intenten arreglar su relación, pero ella lo desprecia; Doris se hace la víctima y chantajea emocionalmente a su padre; Octavio queda impresionado al ver la nueva imagen de Simona.

Fina y Roberta hablan del embarazo y acuerdan hacerse un legrado. Benjamín busca a Renata, le dice que volvió por ella. Antonio le da un anillo a Regina y le pide que hagan un compromiso de vida. Fina se entera que Roberta tiene problemas cardíacos.

Alejandro comienza a dudar de Andrea y la cuestiona sobre el bebé que perdió. En un centro comercial, una mujer distrae a Rocky mientras unos hombres secuestran a Valeria. Damián finge ayudar a Constancio con el rescate de Valeria.
Óscar enfurece al ver que no puede caminar. Ricardo le confiesa a Ruth que Gabriela es su verdadera madre. Juan salva a Gabriela al ver que su camioneta no tiene frenos.
Alejandra le confiesa a Karim que no ha dejado de amar a Octavio; Doris se entera de que Octavio está internado en México y va a visitarlo.
Octavio está triste y enojado, pues Maricruz no ha ido al hospital a buscarlo, ni ha llevado a su hija; Lucía está muy preocupada por la operación de su hijo.
Doris amenaza a María Alejandra con una pistola; Miguel le dice a Octavio que la boda de Maricruz y el gobernador ha sido anunciada en el periódico.

Maricruz le dice a Octavio que se va a casar con el gobernador a como de lugar; Doris inventa un suicidio para que su padre no se case con María Alejandra; Sonia convence a Simona de cambiarse la imagen.
Adriana platica con Honorio en el hospital y le dice que le cae muy bien la visita, también menciona que no le comente nada sobre que está desahuciada.
Matías y Renata caminan de la mano por el jardín, Matías se nota feliz, pero le dice que está muy seria y reflexiva. Renata es honesta con Matías y le menciona que no hay vuelta atrás, que no lo ama.

Renata le cuenta a Adri que terminó con Matías porque no lo quiere engañar y que siente algo por Jerónimo. Un encapuchado ataca a Regina con un cuchillo enviándola al hospital. Gonzalo se entera del atentado a Regina y va a verla.

Jerónimo llama a Roberta para despedirse y le dice que vuelve a España, Renata los escucha y va al aeropuerto. El médico les dice a Inés e Isidro que Andresito tiene leucemia. Fina descubre que Roberta está embarazada.
Héctor opera a Teresa y logra estabilizarla. Aída le reclama a Mariano por preocuparse por la salud de Teresa. Mariano termina con Aída porque nunca va a poder amarla.

A turf battle between New York City street gangs that rages from Coney Island to the Bronx. The Warriors are mistakenly fingered for the killing of a gang leader. Soon they have every gang in the city out to get revenge, and they must make their way across the city to their own turf.

Mike Sullivan (Tom Hanks) is an enforcer for powerful Depression-era Midwestern mobster John Rooney (Paul Newman). Rooney's son, Connor (Daniel Craig), is jealous of the close bond they share, and when Mike's eldest son, Michael (Tyler Hoechlin), witnesses a hit, Connor uses the incident as an excuse to murder Sullivan's wife (Jennifer Jason Leigh) and youngest son. Forced to flee, Sullivan and Michael set out on a journey of revenge and self-discovery.

Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York.

When an inner-city Detroit foster mother (Fionnula Flanagan) is murdered in a botched holdup, four of her now-grown adopted children suspect it was no random killing. Rising musician Jack (Garrett Hedlund), former-Marine Angel (Tyrese Gibson), hotheaded hockey player Bobby (Mark Wahlberg) and settled-down husband and father Jeremiah (André Benjamin) go on the hunt for neighborhood criminal kingpin Victor Sweet (Chiwetel Ejiofor) while being trailed themselves by the local beat cops.
Movie, Crime drama, Action, Dark comedy, Thriller, Mystery

After building an empire with bootleg alcohol, legendary crime boss Al Capone (Robert De Niro) rules Chicago with an iron fist. Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness (Kevin Costner) attempts to take Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force. Recruiting an elite group of lawmen who won't be swayed by bribes or fear, including Irish-American cop Jim Malone (Sean Connery), Ness renews his determination to bring Capone to justice.

Ollie Trinke is young and at the top of his game as a music promoter. He is both a workaholic and a silver-tongued expert at manipulating the press. At a company Christmas party, Ollie meets Gertrude Steiney, a book editor for a New York publishing house. They are instantly attracted to each other, and begin a whirlwind romance that changes the course of his personal and professional life.

Wren (Victoria Justice) is a high-school senior who can't wait to get away from her dysfunctional family. On Halloween, Wren's mother decides to go out with her much-younger boyfriend, leaving Wren to look after little brother Albert. When Wren is distracted by an invitation to the party of the year, Albert disappears into a sea of trick-or-treaters. Enlisting the aid of her sassy friend, April (Jane Levy), and two other classmates, Wren sets out on a frantic search for her sibling.

Before embarking on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip, Andy Brewster pays a visit to his overbearing mother, Joyce. That proves to be a big mistake; Andy caves in under pressure to take his mom along for the ride. Early on -- as the miles roll by -- Andy feels nothing but aggravation at her antics. Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs.

Mavis Gary (Charlize Theron) is a successful writer of teen literature who returns to her hometown with a dual mission: to relive her glory days and steal away her now-married high-school sweetheart (Patrick Wilson). However, her mission does not go exactly to plan, and she finds her homecoming more problematic than she expected. Instead, Mavis forms an unusual bond with a former classmate (Patton Oswalt), who has also found it difficult to move past high school.

When Coast Guard Adm. Frank Beardsley (Dennis Quaid) decides to move his family of eight children back to his old hometown, he encounters handbag designer Helen North (Rene Russo), an old flame from high school. Immediately, sparks fly between the two, and marriage is proposed. But Frank isn't the only one with kids to worry about -- Helen has a total of 10. Right away, the children have no intention of playing nicely, and together they decide to sabotage their parents' relationship.
Teen misfits (Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson) at a modest burger joint face competition from a hamburger emporium across the street.

When he was a child, Dickie Roberts (David Spade) was one of the stars of a popular TV show. But now Dickie is grown up, and, instead of living a life of luxury, he works as a valet attendant and hangs out with other former child stars. Desperate to make a comeback, Dickie hires an ordinary family to live with so he can experience the childhood he never had. Soon Dickie is sharing a room with siblings Sally (Jenna Boyd) and Sam (Scott Terra) and discovering what family is all about.

In 1969 Florida, reporter Ward Jansen (Matthew McConaughey) returns to his hometown to write a story about death-row inmate Hillary Van Wetter (John Cusack), who was convicted of murdering a racist lawman. Ward hires his younger brother, Jack (Zac Efron), as a driver and, together with his partner, Yardley (David Oyelowo), gets to work. Though the possibility exists that Van Wetter is innocent, Ward and Yardley unwisely trust a vixen (Nicole Kidman) who will do anything to set the convict free.

While robbing a mob-owned hangout, two lovers (Michael Pitt, Nina Arianda) stumble upon a secret that could help the FBI dismantle New York's crime syndicate.

As a puppy, Bella finds her way into the arms of Lucas, a young man who gives her a good home. When Bella becomes separated from Lucas, she soon finds herself on an epic 400-mile journey to reunite with her beloved owner. Along the way, the lost but spirited dog touches the lives of an orphaned mountain lion, a down-on-his-luck veteran and some friendly strangers who happen to cross her path.

When lively lounge singer Deloris Van Cartier (Whoopi Goldberg) sees her mobster beau, Vince LaRocca (Harvey Keitel), commit murder, she is relocated for her protection. Set up in the guise of a nun in a California convent, Deloris proceeds to upend the quiet lives of the resident sisters. In an effort to keep her out of trouble, they assign Deloris to the convent's choir, an ensemble that she soon turns into a vibrant and soulful act that gains widespread attention.

Life always seems complicated for good ol' Charlie Brown (Noah Schnapp), the boy who always tries his best against seemingly impossible odds. When the Little Red-Haired Girl moves into his neighborhood, Charlie Brown develops a crush on her. Meanwhile, his best friend Snoopy embarks on an epic adventure in a fantasy world. As a World War I flying ace, the lovable beagle pursues his nemesis, the Red Baron, while also trying to win the heart of a beautiful poodle named Fifi (Kristin Chenoweth).

Tom and Kate Baker compromise their careers to raise 12 children. Tom coaches a high-school football team, while Kate has retired from journalism to raise the family. Things change when Tom is offered a college coaching job in a new city at the same time a publisher buys Kate's parenting memoir. After moving, Kate goes on a book tour, leaving Tom in charge of the children. The children, already unhappy about relocating, plunge the household into chaos.
An unemployed actor disguises himself as an elderly nanny in order to spend more time with his estranged family.
Three Hong Kong gang fighters (Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Jacky Cheung, Waise Lee) try crime in Vietnam and land in a prison camp with U.S. soldiers.
After his wife is brutally murdered, a martial-arts master (Scott Adkins) teams up with an old friend (Kane Kosugi) to sharpen his battle skills and seek revenge.
The son (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) of a fallen police officer joins the NYPD, where he falls in with his father's former partner and a band of rogue cops.

The unthinkable happens when heavily armed and highly trained terrorists launch a bold daytime attack on the White House. The building is overrun, and President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) and his staff are taken hostage. Luckily for Asher, former presidential security officer Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) is on the scene. With time running out, it's up to Banning to locate Asher's son before the extremists do and rescue the president before his captors unleash their ultimate plan.

A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

Following a grueling five-week shift at an Alaskan oil refinery, workers led by sharpshooter John Ottway are flying home for a much-needed vacation. A brutal storm causes their plane to crash in the frozen wilderness, and only eight men, including Ottway, survive. As they trek southward toward civilization and safety, Ottway and his companions must battle mortal injuries, the icy elements, and a pack of hungry wolves.

Insurance salesman Michael MacCauley is on his daily commute home, which becomes anything but routine. After being contacted by a stranger, Michael is forced to uncover the identity of a hidden passenger on the train before the last stop. As he works against the clock to solve the puzzle, he realizes a plan is unfolding, and he is caught up in a criminal conspiracy that carries life and death stakes for everyone on the train.

Zoe wants a baby, but she's single and tired of the saturated New York City dating scene, so she decides to use an anonymous sperm donor. When she becomes pregnant, things get complicated.

In the wake of their friends' marriages and eventual offspring, longtime pals Julie (Jennifer Westfeldt) and Jason (Adam Scott) decide to have a child together without becoming a couple. By becoming "time-share" parents, they reason, they can experience the joys of parenthood without significantly curbing their personal freedom. However, when Julie and Jason both become involved with others, they discover that they secretly harbor romantic feelings for each other.

Seventeen-year-old Stella spends most of her time in the hospital as a cystic fibrosis patient. Her life is full of routines, boundaries and self-control -- all of which get put to the test when she meets Will, an impossibly charming teen who has the same illness. There's an instant flirtation, though restrictions dictate that they must maintain a safe distance between them. As their connection intensifies, so does the temptation to throw the rules out the window and embrace that attraction.
Trapped in a loveless marriage and desperate for excitement, a doctor's wife (Mia Wasikowska) seeks love and fulfillment outside the bonds of matrimony.

Ismael le dice a Aurelio que Salvio es el Ingeniero. Casillas se sorprende al saber que el novio de la Tata es uno de sus enemigos.
Mónica presiente que la Felina la quiere traicionar. Robles sospecha que la colombiana le quiere poner una trampa.
Aurelio prepara a sus hombres para atacar al Ingeniero. Casillas teme que su enemigo le haga daño a su hijo y a la Tata.

Víctor pelea con Mónica por sus celos; cree que ella continúa enamorada de su tío, Aurelio Casillas. La Tata llama a Aurelio para aclararle su situación con el Ingeniero.

Aurelio Casillas y Víctor se enfrentan por Mónica; Aurelio está preocupado por la seguridad de Mónica y su hijo.
Mónica y Aurelio se hacen una importante confesión. Feyo llega de sorpresa al bar de la Tata para averiguar qué es lo que se trae entre manos el Ingeniero.
Chacortica anuncia que compró una hacienda para vivir con su mujer, Mónica, y con los niños que van a adoptar.
Jaimito el Cartero no tiene dinero para pagar su renta y sin pensarlo se esconde del señor Barriga. El Chavo y sus amigos tratan de componer unas sillas, pero solo logran destruirlas.
Don Ramón quema su ropa con la plancha; Popis y El Chavo juegan a los bomberos, pero gracias a Quico, el profesor Jirafales y doña Florinda piensan que su casa se incendia.

En la vecindad, la Popis, el Chavo y Quico hacen figuras con lodo, Doña Florinda se molesta al ver todo manchado. Quico dice a Florinda que la vecindad es muy vieja y la compara con Doña Clotilde, ella se molesta y lo tacha de mal educado.
El Chavo y Quico se pelean, pero el profesor Jirafales los hace reconciliar. Más tarde el Chavo ayuda a todos a pintar la vecindad para que no les cobren un mes de renta.

El profesor Jirafales les hace un examen sorpresa de geografía a sus alumnos. El Chavo comienza a hacer su propia casa en el patio de la vecindad y Quico la destruye por venganza.

Don Justo soborna a Justito y a Victoria para que no le digan a la familia que tiene dinero escondido. Enrique Durán, un antiguo amor de Renta, regresa para tratar de conquistarla de nuevo.

Es el cumpleaños de Albertano y doña Lucha le organiza una fiesta, María se pinta el cabello y se pone su más lindo vestido para recuperar a Albertano, le dedica canciones compuestas por ella y le recita un poema. Doña Lucha se siente mal.

Albertano le pide tiempo a María para pensar en el futuro de su relación y ella va con un brujo para pedirle ayuda. Doña Lucha intenta hablar con el chino sobre sexualidad, por lo que van a la fonda de Don Carmelo, donde ella termina ebria.

Federica hace planes para comer con sus papás, pero Ludovico muere por ver el fútbol, así que arma una estrategia para regresar temprano a casa. En casa de sus suegros, Ludovico se las ingenia para estar enterado de cómo va el partido.

Federica se encuentra a su amiga Columba y las indirectas entre ellas no se hacen esperar; Federica quiere vengarse de que Columba y Basilio les ganaron en el dominó, los invitan a una fiesta, pero ellos a cambio de ir les piden varios favores.

El padre de Víctor, Rulex, conquista a toda mujer que tiene a la mano y sin responsabilidad las embaraza para pronto abandonarlas; Víctor es testigo cuando quiere deshacerse de Adela, pero pronto la convence para que juntos le den una lección.

Ana Lucía y Santiago se reencuentran, pero Soledad se opone a su relación. Ramiro le confiesa a Ana Laura que la ama y quiere casarse con ella, pero lo rechaza al creer que solo la quiere por lástima.

Margarita le pide a Federico que le regrese la presidencia del consejo de la empresa a su padre. Elena regresa a su casa. Jorge le exige a Raquel que se vaya de su casa tras descubrir que su enfermedad es falsa.

Ana Laura cree que Ramiro solo la quiere por interés. Ana Lucía le revela a Santiago el significado de su tatuaje.

Valente le pide una oportunidad a Raquel para ganar su corazón, pero ella se niega asegurando que está enamorada de Jorge. Verónica sufre al recordar los hermosos momentos que pasó con Guillermo en su casa.
Carmina le confiesa a Begoña que fue amante de Edmundo. La bala en la cabeza de Gabino no puede ser extraída. Tras la desaparición de Elisa y Damián, Carmina cree que los dos están muertos.

Quica arruina el vestido de novia de Leona al arrojarle una copa de vino tinto. Jeremías le revela a Lola que el padre biológico de Benjamín es Gael. David se opone a que Leona se case con Gael. Teo le confiesa a Ana Julia que está enamorado de ella.

El esposo de Martha se decepciona porque ella decidió operarse. Los padres de Fernando llegan de viaje y le piden un informe acerca de la situación de la empresa. Simón intenta que incluyan a Jazmín en la coreografía de Bela Life.
Las del club escuchan a Alicia decir que se hizo unos análisis de sangre; Martha habla al laboratorio y, a nombre de Alicia, pide que hagan una prueba de embarazo y se la envíen.

Luigi le niega a Fernando despedir a Fátima; Fernando se altera porque Alicia no llega; Marcia le reclama a Lety no tener efectivo para pagos; Martha atiende el teléfono de Lety y le dice frente a Fernando que le habló su novio Tomás.
Fernando duda de la honestidad de Lety; las secretarias deciden hacer dieta en solidaridad con Martha, pero un mesero les revela que Martha está devorando todo; Fernando le encarga la oficina a Lety.
Fernando se entera de que Fátima se emborrachó y lo anda buscando; Fernando le cuenta a Marcia que Luigi despidió a Fátima y le pide a Jazmín que la sustituya.

Omar convence a Fernando para dejar entrar a las del club a un importante evento; el guardia reconoce a Paco y lo deja entrar con Jaimito y Clarita; Marcia se molesta con Fernando por desautorizarla ante las del club.
Simón convence a Jazmín de cenar con él y le dice a Efrén que saldrá con las bailarinas; Paula María convence a Simón de irse con ella.

Omar le sugiere a Fernando emborracharse para poder ver a Lety más bonita; Simón intenta conquistar a Paula María y ella les confiesa a las del club que no puede estar con él porque no tiene dinero.
El licenciado Sánchez le sugiere a Tomás seguir con el embargo a Conceptos, pero Tomás se niega.
Fernando le dice a Omar que Lety no quiere a Tomás. Tomás le cuenta a Lety todo lo que ha pasado con el licenciado Sánchez. Simón le pide a Paula María formalizar su relación, pero ella lo rechaza.
Marcia le pide a Lola que le explique por qué las despidió Juanita y le ofrece un préstamo para pagar el celular de Jazmín. Tomás le da una carta a los niños para que se la entreguen a Alicia.

Omar ignora las insinuaciones de Alicia; Lety se molesta porque Omar invita a Fernando a salir con las modelos; Fernando le dice a Lety que no ama a Marcia y le pide que se den una oportunidad para descubrir lo que sienten.

Ralph Angel tries to run the farm while the other siblings return to their everyday lives; Nova thinks that a friend's son has been wrongfully imprisoned and tries to help; Charley resumes managing her husband despite their strained relationship.

Two families, bound by tradition, are locked in a brutal war. Asian and African American gangs are vying for control of Oakland's waterfront. But when the first casualty is the Asian warlord's son, the gang war becomes more dangerous than either side ever imagined.

In this fact-based film, a New Jersey superintendent, Dr. Frank Napier (Robert Guillaume), watches helplessly as East Side High becomes the lowest-ranked school in the state. With nowhere else to turn, Dr. Napier enlists maverick ex-teacher Joe Clark (Morgan Freeman) to take over as principal of the declining school. Unfortunately for Clark, before he can focus on improving the student body's state exam scores, he has to somehow rid the school of its gang and narcotics problems.

The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward a collision course with Earth. With only weeks before impact, NASA executive Jacinda "Jo" Fowler teams up with a man from her past and a conspiracy theorist for an impossible mission into space to save humanity.

Once a first-rate Secret Service agent, Joe Hallenbeck (Bruce Willis) is now a gruff private investigator whose latest gig is protecting a pole dancer (Halle Berry). When she's murdered, he grudgingly teams up with her boyfriend, Jimmy Dix (Damon Wayans), an ex-quarterback with a gambling problem, and the two go after her killers. Before long, they stumble onto a plot by a well-known football magnate (Noble Willingham) to bribe federal legislators into legalizing sports gambling.

Three Midwestern brothers, a crime lord, and an incorruptible cop are on a deadly collision course when the youngest brother's fiancée is kidnapped by human traffickers. To save her, the MacGregor boys call on their military training -- and the strength of family -- to fight the most important battle of their lives.

American submarine Capt. Joe Glass is on the hunt for a U.S. sub in distress in the Arctic Ocean. He soon learns that a secret Russian coup is in the offing, a conspiracy that threatens to dismantle the world order. With crew and country on the line, Glass must assemble an elite group of Navy SEALs to sneak through enemy waters, rescue the kidnapped Russian president and prevent World War III.
A disgraced cop teams up with a livestreaming news broadcaster to try and save the police chief's kidnapped daughter.
A former special forces agent's son is kidnapped and must now wipe out three dangerous crime syndicates, if he wants to see his son alive again.

Tough and chiseled Ray Breslin (Sylvester Stallone) knows how to infiltrate a prison -- and bust out of one. His latest job leads to a double-cross, leaving him stuck in a high-tech facility with the worst that society has to offer. Luckily for Ray, he meets Emil Rottmayer (Arnold Schwarzenegger), an inmate who secretly helps him hatch a plot to win his freedom. Only sadistic warden Hobbes (Jim Caviezel) stands in the way of the two men successfully making it out alive.

In Leyton, Tariq and Sairah want to turn their dumping ground of a backyard into a sumptuous award-winning garden, suitable for entertaining friends and family. Both have competitive jobs in the banking sector and are used to winning at work but when it comes to gardening, they don't know where to begin.

One couple battle to turn a clay-clogged building site in Sussex into a piece of Portugal. Another tackle a forest of overgrowth in their new back garden in Cadeby. They are determined to create a productive space, something they have always wanted.

A truck driver from Wakefield with a passion for flowers wants to create a perfect outside space for his girlfriend and burgeoning family, while in Swindon a widow wants to find the best way of turning her bleak patch of green into a cottage garden.

Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.
Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

Monty travels across the south-west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

Monty continues planting up perennials in his recently extended orchard beds and begins a redesign in the dry garden. Toby Buckland explores the impressive collection of heritage daffodils at Cotehele in Cornwall.

It's the Easter bank holiday, and at Longmeadow, Monty turns his attention to planting up his new bog garden, sows cucumber and melon seeds and continues with changes to the dry garden. Monty continues his revamp of the dry garden, repots succulents and plants up a window box, while Frances Tophill visits a north London garden which has sustainable produce at its core.

Drawn to small town Iowa by reports of aggressive shadow figures, Nick and Katrina venture to the harrowing halls of Malvern Manor to capture evidence of the fearsome phenomenon.
On the 10th anniversary of New Orleans' most gruesome murder, the death of Addie Hall by her boyfriend Zack Bowen, Nick and Katrina return to the scene of the crime to find what spirits still remain.
After the owner's tragic death, a Victorian mansion reportedly curses all who live inside, and Nick and Katrina find the curse may be even more dangerous than they anticipated.
Nick and Katrina investigate a haunted jail in Savannah; haunted by phantom noises during their confinement, they realize that they are not alone.
Nick and Katrina submerge themselves among the spirits of West Virginia's Old Sweet Springs Resort to see what lurks beneath the surface of the once-idyllic retreat.
Nick and Katrina go to Wildwood Sanitarium; after its conversion into apartments, tenants report an unnerving male presence and furniture being rearranged.
An unknown spirit lurks in the empty hallways of Ohio's Higginsport School; evidence points to darker haunting caused by recent deaths on the property.
Nick and Katrina use high-tech equipment to face down the dark spirits in one of America's most notorious haunted hotspots - Bobby Mackey's Music World.
After Nick and Katrina found human bones in their first lockdown at the Monroe House, they thought the case was closed; now they return to explore further.
Nick and Katrina are in the historic Jim Beam Distillery, exploring employee claims that bourbon is not the only spirit locked inside its huge warehouse.

When the spirit of a possessed girl starts calling, Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey pick up the line; while communicating with the ghostly caller in Watseka, Ill., they find there's more to her death than anyone suspected.

Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey check into a Michigan asylum to determine what truly haunts its abandoned grounds; as the guys sift through the facility's sordid past, they encounter restless souls who refuse to be forgotten in death.

Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey investigate the site of Louisiana's first double execution; as they dive into the murky waters of the old Beauregard Parish jail's murderous past, the resident spirits begin to tell an unexpected tale.

After her mother dies, a young woman returns to her hometown to take custody of her 12-year-old half sister. As she confronts her troubled past, she finds solace in an old classmate who gave up his sports dreams to paint watercolors.
In the 10 years before the creation of Mickey Mouse, Walt Disney struggles to master the art and business of animation.
Encouraged by his grandfather, a boy faces his fears and makes new friends at summer camp.
Ray Berry, an NSA analyst, becomes involved in a top-secret investigation when a computer virus crashes the government's computers.

Donna Lawrence, the survivor of a pit bull attack, adopts a pit bull mix puppy that was beaten, set afire and left for dead. Together, they learn to love and forgive as they seek justice and protection for all animals.
A struggling musician becomes a 12-year-old musical prodigy's guardian for a summer.
With the latest film-making technology, Sir David Attenborough uncovers the unseen natural treasures of Singapore and explores how the wildlife has adapted to the human world.
On the Mediterranean island farthest from any mainland, where many flightless animals died out, we discover a story never told before.

An enormous territory of endless plains that changes its appearance twice a year, sometimes appearing flooded, other times looking nearly desiccated; a place of highly contrasting landscapes; the capybara.
Showcases the lives of a white-breasted waterhen and orphaned lesser whistling ducklings in the Singapore Botanic Gardens.
Grassland is the Earth's second-largest ecosystem on land; China's grassland makes up an important part of the Eurasian Steppe.
Nirut is on a mission to track a common krait that attacked a man in his own bed; this silent killer produces neurotoxins that paralyze its victims, making it one of Thailand's most lethal snakes.
Malaysian superstar Michelle Yeoh returns to home to see her adopted orangutan for first time.
Special instruments for eating, including spoons, knives and forks.
Tom explores the traditional Sunday lunch and cooks roast beef, and chocolate and ale cake.
Carolyn Scott-Hamilton, the Healthy Voyager, demonstrates how to prepare vegan buffalo black bean quinoa burgers with special guest Nick Loeb.

In Arcachon, France, Tony first learned to love food as a child; in a nostalgic trip down memory lane, he enjoys the food of his childhood including steak frites, gaufres (waffles), soupe de pêcheur (fisherman's soup) and fresh oysters.
Eateries in the red-light district highlight the night Tony spends in Bangkok.
The Japanese have a healthy respect for food, which Tony can definitely appreciate; a trip through a market with a sushi chef prepares Tony for his dinner; he also eats a meal with sumo wrestlers.

Jeremy begins with a party platter containing steamed bao with black pepper beef short-rib filling; he teaches Joe how to make salt and pepper chili squid; Jeremy fires up the barbecue to make a soy chicken burrito.

Jeremy starts with Guangxi steamed chicken before teaching Joe how to make char siu puffs; after a lesson in foraging, Jeremy creates a tempura medley of mushrooms, finishing with an apple sesame loaf cake.

Yotam begins his Mediterranean journey in the vibrant city of Marrakesh, inspiring his inner chef to create; he then travels to the luminous Atlas Mountains to dine with the Berbers before venturing onward to the coastal town of Essaouira.

Yotam travels to the stunning French island of Corsica, where he discovers how the lush green landscape, called the maquis, flavours and infuses the food, from charcuterie and olive oil to cheese and honey.
Felicity and husband Peter of Killykeen Forest Park create a dish that reminds Eoin of home in Drumelis: Atlantic Seafood in a coconut broth with basil and truffle mash plus crisp green veggies.

Hosted by TV chef Catherine Fulvio, this cooking show focuses on the Irish families who have loved ones living abroad; contestants share recipes and foods that remind them of their childhood and the loved ones they're missing.

Ireland's top Indian takeaways spice and sizzle it up in the kitchen hoping to please the palates of Chef Dylan McGrath, takeaway expert Suzie Lee, and celebrity judge Hugh Wallace, for a chance at competing in the final cook off.

Ember-roasted salsa with grilled tortillas; bacon, bean and egg quesadillas; chipotle-marinated pork tenderloin with grilled nopalitos corn salad; spice-grilled pineapple with mezcal and whipped cream.

Turkish cuisine channels cultural currents from all compass points, and Istanbul is the city to experience this cornucopia of unique culinary dishes; Ottolenghi dines at Asitane Restaurant, visits the Grand Bazaar and more.

In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

Jonathan Shannon (Ryan Phillippe) gives his 17-year-old daughter Clare (Joey King) an old music box that promises to grant its owner seven wishes. Skeptical at first, Clare becomes seduced by its dark powers when her life starts to radically improve with each wish. Everything seems perfect until she realizes that every wish she makes causes the people who are closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.
In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for survivors while coping with an unborn child growing inside her.

The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

Stuck working the late shift at the amusement park arcade, Alex receives a surprise visit from her friends on her 21st birthday. However, their night of fun soon turns into a fight for survival when a killer dressed as Mickey Mouse crashes the party.

In Northern California during the summer of 1986, Olive Oyl, along with her cinema-obsessed friends and brother Castor, embark on a once-in-a-lifetime camping trip to witness the dazzling meteor shower accompanying the arrival of Halley's comet. But what starts as a serene evening of stargazing quickly turns into a harrowing nightmare when a meteor from the comet transforms Popeye, into a terrifying and unstoppable killing machine.

The night before Claire Reynolds' trip to Paris, she catches the eye of a mysterious, handsome stranger. That's the last thing she remembers before waking up on a plane with no recollection of what happened after.

The chefs must prepare fish courses, and after some exceptionally high-scoring dishes in the starter round, everyone is desperate to deliver perfection. Once again, the chefs present their innovative, witty and heart-warming creations.

It's main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. Both chefs and judges alike are amazed at the high standard of cooking and an incredible number of 10s are dished out as the chefs serve up venison, rabbit, duck, beef, lamb and pork for scrutiny.

It's dessert day and with just one place remaining at the banquet feast, each chef is giving everything they've got for a chance to say thank you to the heroic NHS staff. All the chefs have significantly re-worked or re-invented their desserts since the regional heats, proving that they'll do everything they can in a bid for that final winning spot.

It's the grand finale as the winning chefs cook their dishes at a banquet for the heroes of the NHS. Having arrived at St Bartholomew's Hospital, the chefs are shown the incredible location for event, the almost three-hundred-year-old Great Hall.
Competing for the top spot are 3 new chefs to the competition representing some of the most exciting culinary talent from London, Paul Walsh, Luke Selby and Ben Marks.

The three chefs are halfway through their heat and the pressure is mounting. Only two will proceed to Friday's judging and have a chance to represent the London and the South East region at the regional finals.

The two remaining London chefs must cook their four-course menus again. The chefs need to impress the formidable judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

Three chefs new to the competition compete in the North East heats. Three of the region's chefs battle it out for the top spot: Mike Carr, Samira Effa, and Tom Anglesea. The three chefs must present the menu of their careers, inspired by 50 years of British pop music.

The chefs are halfway through their heat and will serve up their main courses and desserts. The stakes are high, and again they are each serving a unique take on the pop music brief. Mike is confident about his northern dish, 'Rack n Roll', which puts both classic Yorkshire hogget and traditional Lancashire hotpot in the spotlight.

The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four-course menus again for the judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the British pop industry's finest.

Newcomer Kray brings an urban edge to proceedings, with a starter inspired by grime music called 'Fire in the Booth'. It combines hot sauce, veal sweetbreads and tuna belly. Returner Sabrina is compiling a dish of her favourite ingredients, including pasta and ox cheek, for her Italian inspired starter called 'My Mixtape'.

For his main course, Ryan Simpson-Trotman is confident his dish, `The UK's Number 1', will hit the top spot with his combination of a beef pie and rump cap. Sabrina Gidda is taking inspiration from her grandad's collection of old 45s for her `Sunday Jukebox' main: pork Wellington and Black Country faggots.

And something else is back in Harmony: a pickaxe-wielding killer in a miner's mask, who may be the ghost of Harry, come to claim Tom and his friends.
